title: Fantasy football 2026 rankings: The top-300 players to know for draft season
content:
The 2026 fantasy football season is quickly approaching, which means it’s time for a fresh update to the rankings.

From now until the regular season, I will continually update them given news, injuries, training camp updates and more (look to the top right-hand corner of the rankings to see when they were last adjusted).

Want a quick reference for your draft evaluations? Use our new Draft Assistant to compare up to five players side-by-side to see fantasy scouting reports, rankings and point projections before or during your draft.

Below you’ll find a top-300 overall, which I don’t love, but people demand. I always recommend drafting positionally and using tiers, as this will give you a better team build and chance at winning. The overall rankings need more context. Speaking of which, don’t waste your bench in the later rounds. There are some low-ceiling veterans in that mix — I won’t devalue them completely, as roster makeup can help boost their values; however, you want your bench comprised of players who can be potential weekly starters (shoot for the ceiling). That’s why you’ll sometimes see high-risk/high-reward players a bit higher than you might think.

As always, feel free to jump into the comments for questions, more context, debates, or to talk cartoons and video games like usual.
